addSource.title: Add source to "{{collection}}"
addSource.description: Attach a PDF or paste a URL. Indexing runs in the background with a relevance gate before enrichment.
addSource.crawlEnabledHelp: When enabled, follows same-origin links up to the limits below. The gate drops irrelevant pages before enrichment.
addSource.requiredPathHelp: Literal substring. Pages whose URL doesn't contain this text are skipped. Useful to pin a docs version (e.g. Unity 6000.3) and avoid drift into others. Leave blank to disable.
addSource.llmExtractLinks: Use an LLM to extract links (advanced)
addSource.llmExtractLinksHelp: Runs an LLM on the seed page to find URLs the HTML parser misses (JS-rendered sidebars, data attributes, embedded JSON). One LLM call per source. Useful for sites like Unity ScriptReference. Configure the model in Admin → Pipelines → doc_ingest/link_extractor.
addSource.forceBrowserHelp: Fetches every page with a headless browser instead of plain HTTP — captures sidebars / menus / nav populated by JavaScript (e.g. Unity ScriptReference, sites with an SPA shell). Requires ChromeService enabled in Admin → Chrome Service. Each page takes ~15-30s (vs ~100ms plain), only use when needed. When ChromeService is disabled, indexing degrades to plain and marks each page with force_browser_unavailable.
addSource.browserSeedOnly: Chromium on the seed only, plain HTTP for the rest (recommended for Unity-style docs)
addSource.browserSeedOnlyHelp: Hybrid mode: Chromium runs JS on the seed URL only — surfaces links the HTML parser misses (Unity ScriptReference sidebar, Docusaurus hash-router nav, etc.). Every discovered leaf is then fetched via plain HTTP, since each leaf is usually static HTML once you have the URL. Much cheaper than force_browser: 1× slow (seed) + N× fast (leaves). Disabled when force_browser is on (force_browser wins).
addSource.folderPathHelp: ABSOLUTE path on the server where MCP is running. Useful for indexing offline documentation (Unity Editor, downloaded books, corporate manuals) without a crawler. Validated upfront: must exist, be a directory, and be readable.
addSource.folderBypassGateHelp: When on (default), we skip the LLM step that decides whether each file is "real docs" — for folders like Unity ScriptReference this is unnecessary (it's all docs). Turn off if the folder mixes docs with other content and you want filtering.
addSource.pathInvalidNotDir: Path exists but is not a directory.
addSource.pathInvalidNotReadable: Path is not readable by the server process.
addSource.pdfDropzone: Drag a PDF here or click to choose
addSource.pdfTooLarge: File too large ({{size}} MB). Limit: 50 MB.

sources.forceReembedDescription: This wipes ALL vector mappings for this source in SQLite and re-embeds from scratch. Use when you suspect the remote vector store silently rejected earlier upserts (green badge but search returns 0 even on queries that should match). The text chunks stay intact — only embed + upsert is re-run.

sources.forceReembedActionTitle: Force re-embed (wipe + retry) — use when search returns 0 despite the green badge (remote upsert silently rejected).
sources.reembedActionTitle: Embed only the missing chunks (without re-fetching the page).
